https://myai-stackguide.invalid/contract.title: Request-specific eligibility independent from catalog status
x-invariants: github_repository_id is the same positive integer used by the card, retrieval candidate and evidence-pack join.
Checks cover mandatory query fields plus availability, archived and advisory_evidence; duplicates and omitted checks fail.

For a target card JSON pointer t, a source evidence pointer p covers t exactly when p == t or t starts with p + '/'. The root pointer '/', sibling prefixes and cross-section prefixes never cover t; plain string-prefix matching is forbidden.

Every supplied evidence_ref resolves to a card evidence item whose verification is not unknown and whose fields cover at least one target pointer for that check. Pass or fail requires the referenced items collectively to cover every target pointer; unknown may use no refs or incomplete verified coverage and requires a concrete next verification. advisory_evidence targets /advisory/use_cases, /advisory/best_for, /advisory/adoption_mode, /advisory/project_stages, /advisory/complexity, /advisory/integration_surface and /advisory/compatibility.

primary_eligible requires an available, explicitly unarchived card, traced advisory fields and all mandatory facts satisfied. Unknowns remain references with concrete next checks; archive status alone is not evidence of operability.

https://myai-stackguide.invalid/contract.title: Bounded literal catalog query, never SQL
x-invariants: Query IDs, variants and terms are unique; canonicalize aliases before lookup on both index and query. Quote literal terms and bind the MATCH string as a SQL parameter. Never interpolate field names, SQL or MATCH syntax supplied by a model.

The 150-hit ceiling counts all variants including duplicates before canonical dedupe; at most three bounded queries, with remaining budget shared, not 150 per query. A request may choose a lower max_candidates value for narrow intent.

taxonomy_route_id=null is the only unscoped form. A non-null value must exactly equal one canonical route_id in the index-format-3 taxonomy route registry; labels and aliases are not route IDs. An absent route is invalid_query and must not fall back to unscoped lexical search.
taxonomy_route_id is part of the canonical sorted-key query serialization covered by query_sha256, so scoped and unscoped searches cannot share a replay digest.
